headline: Get Popota
title: How to Get Popota | Susuta Level Twenty Nine | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Popota is a Water Breaker and the middle form of the Susuta line. Find Susuta at Echoback Landing and raise it to level twenty nine to get Popota. Its Appeal trait boosts its BREAK when an opposite gender Susuta is in your party. At level thirty nine it becomes Panpanta or Piopiota, so decide before you level it. Which final form do you want? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Popota is a Water Breaker that evolves from Susuta at level 29 (Susuta lives at Echoback Landing). At level 39 it becomes Panpanta or Piopiota.
joke: Water Breaker that needs a partner, just like most of us.
